name: Towa mo Nakaba o Sugite
source:
By taking a pygmy medicine, the boy's height is reduced to only 3cm. He is teased in sexual ways by childhood friend and his juniors, dives between the breasts of a girl, and so on.

[adapted from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE007883.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
服用了一种缩小药后，男孩的身高缩小到了只有3厘米。他被青梅竹马和后辈们以各种色情方式戏弄，潜入女孩的双乳之间，等等。

[改编自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE007883.html]DLsite English[/url]]
